scope: M01-M03 integration into focused PRC rules and agent contract 1.2
approved_methods: EMNLP 2025 requirement detection and slot extraction

rule_summary.instruction: Extract candidate requirements from the effective project specification, including requirements intended for later stages.
Extract the source-supported requirements that govern how this project must be carried out, including constraints that limit the intended result.
Represent each obligation together with the source-stated actor or target, required or prohibited action, applicability, conditions and exceptions.
For every candidate rule, identify the original evidence that supports its full meaning and the project evidence that adopts it.
Give each extracted rule source-grounded applicability and usage timing so downstream tasks receive the requirements they need.
Identify unresolved authority, obligation meaning, contradictions or applicability that prevent a faithful rule package.
Independently review the organized candidate collection against the original project materials and reviewed context before publication.

Reviewer receives actual organized final records, checks all final IDs and binds their hash. Publication reproduces the same records.
Legacy 1.0/1.1 extraction requests match the saved preceding implementation; both publication contracts pass fixtures.
LangGraph/Prefect/Snakemake path retained; resource packaged and included in saved plan code dependencies.
